title.tagline: A hundred masks. One of them lies. One bullet.
title.online_sub: Spy versus sniper, online for two

season.title: THE SEASON
season.sub: Nine balls at the Palazzo Vermeil. In turn the Raven and the Lynx.
season.locked: Win the previous night to open this one.

1.name: The First Ball
1.desc: Your first contract for the Dogaressa. Blend into the crowd, do two missions, don't get shot.

2.name: The Gallery
2.desc: Change of sides: you are the Lynx, up in the gallery. Someone below is not who they claim. One bullet.

3.name: The Minuet of Shadows
3.desc: Three missions out of four, and the Lynx knows the room now. Don't run. Don't double back.

4.name: The Orchids
4.desc: The glasshouse, its palms, its fountain. The spy below is subtler: watch who stops where nobody stops.

5.name: The Countess
5.desc: A bow before Countess Morosini: that is the agreed signal. You still have to find her among a hundred masks.

6.name: The Ambassador's Pockets
6.desc: Someone will pick the Viennese ambassador's pockets. It takes approaching him from behind: watch his back.

7.name: The Grand Staircase
7.desc: The Opera foyer, its mirrors, its boxes. Five possible missions, three to do, and a sniper who no longer forgives.

8.name: The Red Curtain
8.desc: The Raven is the best of the Season. Tonight it's you or him.

9.name: The Last Waltz
9.desc: Four missions out of five. The Dogaressa herself is at the ball. And the Lynx knows exactly who you are… almost.

ball.why_spy_innocent: The Lynx shot an innocent. In the uproar, the Raven slips away.
ball.why_spy_miss: The bullet was lost in the stucco.

party.title: THE ASSASSINS' BALL
party.rules: Each player is a guest among a hundred. Nobody knows who is who: spot the other players by the way they move, and stab them. Stabbing an innocent exposes you (everyone sees you) and costs a point. First to 3.
party.keys_kb: {up}{left}{down}{right} walk · {act} blend in · Shift hurry · {stab} stab
party.keys_kb2: arrows walk · Enter blend in · Ctrl hurry · / or . stab
party.keys_pad: stick walk · A blend in · RB hurry · X stab

online.title: THE CONTRACT
online.rules: For two, online. One is the Raven among the guests, the other the Lynx in the gallery; roles swap every round. The host picks the venue.
online.waiting: Waiting for an opponent… Give them your address: {addr}

ending.credits: MASCARADE — design, code, music: a one-person studio, a hundred masks. Thanks for playing.

1: Come closer, Raven. Tonight my Season opens: nine balls, a hundred masks each night, and all of Venice pretending to have fun.
A letter to copy at my writing desk, a powder to pour at the buffet, a friend to greet. Two of these will do.
And the woman with the rifle, up in the gallery?
The Lynx. She has one bullet, and she hates being wrong. Do what the others do: drink, admire, dance. Never run.
2: Lynx, my dear. A letter was stolen from me last night, under my own roof. The thief will come back: they always do.
A hundred guests, one bullet. What am I looking for?
The one who walks like someone with a purpose. Guests stroll; a spy goes somewhere. And when a candle flickers, he has just acted.
Shoulder, aim, wait. I know the drill.
3: The Lynx looked for me all last night. She shot a silk merchant. He had done nothing.
She learns. So do you, I hope. Three missions tonight, and she knows the room now.
A piece of advice: act when her laser looks elsewhere. The red dot tells you where her eyes are.
4: A glasshouse. Palms, a fountain, glass everywhere. A bad place to shoot.
The Raven likes plants, they say. He already has three of my secrets. I would rather he did not get a fourth.
If I knew who he was, my dear, I would not need you.
5: Countess Morosini wears a mask like everyone tonight. Bow to her: she will know what it means.
You have me rob your own guests, and you pay a sniper to shoot me. I'm starting not to understand your game.
My game is the Season. Nobody understands it before the last waltz.
6: The Raven works for you. I saw him leave your study.
All of Venice leaves my study, my dear. Tonight someone will pick the Viennese ambassador's pockets. If it is him, shoot him.
And if you are the one sending him?
Then you will have proof that I know how to pick my people.
7: The Opera foyer. Mirrors everywhere: she will see me twice.
She has missed six times. She will not miss the seventh. Do your three missions, and do not dance with the same lady twice.
8: I know how he walks now. He stops a second too long in front of paintings. He never really drinks.
Then tonight, you will have him.
And you, Dogaressa, which side are you on?
On the side of whoever wins. It is always the same side.
9: Last waltz, Raven. Tonight I am at the ball. Four missions: the letter, the cipher, the powder… and a bow for me.
I told her who you are. Or rather, I described someone who looks a lot like you. Make her wrong.
Whichever of you is still standing at midnight inherits the House of Vermeil. That is what the Season was.

intro.text: Venice, carnival of 1890. On the Grand Canal, the Palazzo Vermeil lights up for the Season: nine balls, a hundred masks each night.
The Dogaressa Vermeil holds Venice by its secrets. Tonight she hands a sealed letter to a man with no name. They call him the Raven.
In the gallery, a woman shoulders a scoped rifle. The Lynx has one bullet. She is looking for the one, among a hundred guests, who did not come to dance.

finale.text: Midnight. The last waltz ends. In the Lynx’s scope, the Raven looks back at her — and does not look away.
The Dogaressa had hired them both. The best spy in Venice, the best sniper: she wanted to know which one deserved her House.
The Raven won the Season. The Lynx puts her rifle away; they say that next time, they will work together. The masks never come off.
